prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. A four-asset illustration sheet for Android FitnessApp, exercise Curl femoral tumbado (hamstrings_lying_leg_curl). Choose three-quarter SIDE view that makes the movement and joint angles unmistakable. All relevant limbs and equipment fully inside each panel, normal five-finger hands, plausible equipment and joints. Dark studio background #121416, warm soft champagne rim light, consistent photorealistic 3D educational illustration, realistic light loads.
